scope.authorized_question: Can one ordinary RBiH player REQUEST-OP from 4th Corps to Tosici, started from the actual Package03 T16 state and carried through the current-source production interfaces, reach T39 at 707/712 or better with zero formerly-correct losses against n91 and n92?

static_flow_review.roster_contract: canonical 3..12 brigade roster, active and non-enclave at T16, initially uncommitted statewide, same 4th Corps, selected from the production reachable pool
static_flow_review.staging_contract: single axis from op:trnovo:delijas to op:trnovo:tosici
static_flow_review.cross_corps_overlap: Operation Circle is owned by 1st Corps; validateOpAtInjection receives the 4th Corps command, so the ordinary same-corps overlap guard permits this disclosed cross-corps duplicate target without an exemption
static_flow_review.turn_artifacts: canonical state, phase report, and operation/lineage/event receipt for every T17 through T39 turn
static_flow_review.operation_lineage: roster movement receipts plus operation-id-owned or contributing target battles; any Tosici controller change must be RBiH and have this operation's winning battle and a control event
static_flow_review.event_contract: production consumer only; missing, extra, reordered, unresolved, non-player-source, or blocking events fail closed
static_flow_review.partial_failure_retention: RESULT.json records the primary child error; every reached artifact is retained. Missing success artifacts may additionally produce wrapper exit 126 and do not replace the child failure classification.

acceptance.partial_delivery_disposition: Movement, combat, capture, or another delivery signal without the score and zero-loss gates is a failed or partial result, not parity and not baseline adoption.

launch_contract.prelaunch_recheck: Immediately before launch, require the exact FREEZE, CONFIG, entry, and launcher hashes in this review; exact HEAD; clean src/data; unchanged 23 bindings, 11 named rows, local loader, five runtime package aggregates, bound v3 fidelity receipt/artifacts/review; and absent fixed attempt leaf.
launch_contract.stopping_rule: Run once. Stop on success, child failure, wrapper failure, timeout, or any preflight mismatch. Preserve all evidence and do not retry.

nonblocking_disclosures: The bound PLAYER_INPUT_FEASIBILITY_SUPPLEMENT.md is preserved historical proposal evidence and contains the earlier wrong-cohort T16/T17 path identities. V4 does not consume those identities: its CONFIG binds the corrected actual Package03 T16/T17/T39 files and the 704 comparator directly.
This experiment can establish bounded player-input delivery at current source. It cannot establish native full-campaign or same-input full-state parity.
No production output format changes are introduced; this packet adds diagnostic evidence artifacts only.
